you.name: You
you.blurb: Where work starts and where decisions stay.

model.name: The model
model.blurb: A probabilistic engine that predicts one token at a time.

harness.name: Agent harness
harness.blurb: The loop that lets a model use tools: Claude Code, Codex CLI or Pi.

guards.name: Guard ring
guards.blurb: codeArbiter’s enforcement core: plain programs that run outside the model.

skills.name: Routing, skills and agents
skills.blurb: The procedures the orchestrator follows and the agents it dispatches.

lanes.name: Lanes
lanes.blurb: Every codeArbiter lane, each with its own evidence, reviewers and stops.

record.name: The record
record.blurb: The .codearbiter/ store: memory that lives in your repository.

world.name: Your repository
world.blurb: The working tree, branches, the protected default branch and hosted CI.

outside.name: Outside the machine
outside.blurb: Network touches and opt-in previews that reach beyond your machine.

initialize.name: Initialize
initialize.blurb: Create or inspect the repository-owned state store.

change.name: Change
change.blurb: Build, repair, restructure, explore, or change the supply chain through the owning gate.

ship.name: Ship
ship.blurb: Commit, stage a pull request, or prepare an authorized release.

review.name: Review
review.blurb: Run reviewers over a diff, the whole codebase, a design or a deep audit.

decide.name: Decide
decide.blurb: Record, inspect and reconcile decisions; stop on conflicts.

operate.name: Operate
operate.blurb: Inspect state, manage tasks, verify enforcement, or log an allowed bypass.
